transfer.endpoint: u=ceil(x)-1, v=floor(x+y); half-weight transfer and v-u=y+O(1) cost O(log x).
transfer.remainder: At integral u,v, the distance to every other prime power is at least one. For 2<=T<=x the endpoint formula errors are O(x(log x)^3/T).
transfer.height_convention: The |gamma|<T to literal |rho|<=T mismatch is in unit boundary strips and costs O(x log T/T) by the multiplicity-inclusive HSW+Bui count.
